description: This file defines a REST API for managing personal journal entries, including endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting entries, and auxiliary functions for listing entries, filtering by date, and handling image uploads. It also sets up CORS middleware, static file serving, and initializes database connections.

classes.name: DatesWithEntriesResponse
classes.description: A custom JSON response class for date entry responses, mainly used for returning dates with journal entries.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify service is running.

methods.name: HTTPException _structured_500(message: str, context: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Builds a structured HTTPException for 500 errors, optionally including debugging context.

methods.name: list_journal_entries( start_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="End date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), title: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Case-insensitive substring to match in the title"), )
methods.description: Lists journal entries with optional filtering by title substring, start date, and end date.

methods.name: get_dates_with_entries( start_date: date = Query(..., description="Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), end_date: date = Query(..., description="End date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive"), )
methods.description: Retrieves distinct dates within a range that have journal entries.

methods.name: get_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to fetch", ge=1) )
methods.description: Fetches a specific journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: create_journal_entry( title: str = Form(..., description="Title for the journal entry (1..200 chars)"), content: str = Form(..., description="Content/body for the entry (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file"), )
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry, optionally with an uploaded image.

methods.name: update_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to update", ge=1), title: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated title (1..200 chars)"), content: Optional[str] = Form(None, description="Updated content (1..10000 chars)"), image: Optional[UploadFile] = File(None, description="Optional image file to replace existing"), image_remove: Optional[bool] = Form(False, description="Set true to remove existing image"), )
methods.description: Updates an existing journal entry, allowing changes to title, content, and image (including removal).

methods.name: delete_journal_entry( entry_id: int = Path(..., description="The ID of the journal entry to delete", ge=1) )
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry by ID.
